question: With validation and test cells, their labels and the gene panel held fixed, does adding training cells change the Arm B per-cell-minus-Poisson calibration and marker contrasts?
evaluation_cells: the analysed corpus's validation and test cells with their original labels, unchanged

training_sets.x2: x1 plus a random half (seed 0, per dataset) of the extra cells

extra_cells: cells of the 10,000-cell uniform sample (seed 0) that lie outside the original 3000-cell sample, after the original fixed quality control applied to that extra set and with a transferred label (labels are not used in training; the filter keeps the training population comparable)
model: E4 recipe: PCA-512 fitted on the training cells of each set; negative-binomial MLP decoder with the E2 training recipe; Arm A and Arm B
endpoints: as E4: calibration error on each arm's decoded genes; Welch recall@50 on the 1250 held-out genes; draws Poisson, shared per-gene (median validation theta) and per-cell
contrasts: Arm A per-cell minus Poisson calibration error
Arm B per-cell minus Poisson calibration error
Arm B per-cell minus shared calibration error
Arm B per-cell minus Poisson Welch recall
Arm B per-cell minus shared Welch recall
inference_stats: as E4; 2000-resample dataset-cluster bootstrap, seed 20261107; trend reported as the paired x3-minus-x1 difference of dataset effects with its own dataset bootstrap interval
retention: all sizes, seeds and signed effects retained
